import config, daemon, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
root = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
def write(name, data):
    path = root / name
    path.write_bytes(data)
    return path
good = write('good.json', b'{"merge_enabled": false, "max_workers": 2}')
bad = write('bad.json', b'{"merge_enabled": false,}')
state = daemon.reload({'config': dict(config.DEFAULTS), 'degraded': None}, good)
state = daemon.reload(state, bad)
result = [state['config'], bool(state['degraded'])]
